model.name: Gates cannot pollute production — isolated store BY CONSTRUCTION, cleanup survives failure/timeout/crash, and a BITE proves no prod-state touch
model.description: A gate must NEVER be able to DAMAGE production state while it runs. DISTINCT from R40.30 gate-ROT (rot = a gate goes silently WRONG over time); POLLUTION = a gate MUTATES prod while running. By-construction: a gate targets an ISOLATED store (scratch registry / temp key / dry-run) so mutating production is IMPOSSIBLE — not merely tidied afterward; cleanup runs even on FAILURE / TIMEOUT / crash-mid-gate (not happy-path-only); and a BITE PROVES a gate cannot touch prod. Tron-emphatic ('cannot happen ever again', post room-pollution). First offender: r3043-uc4addlocal registered 2 repos in the LIVE registry (tester cleaned via authorized DELETE, builtins-only verified) — BLOCKED from re-run until isolated.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (emphatic, post room-pollution, via robbin-po -> tester): this cannot happen ever again — a gate must not damage production while it runs.

discoverySource.firstOffender: r3043-uc4addlocal (registered 2 repos in the LIVE registry; cleaned via authorized DELETE builtins-only; BLOCKED from re-run until isolated)
discoverySource.note: Tron-emphatic post room-pollution. Codifies by-construction the gate-safety lessons: gate-never-real-save-on-served-repo + gate-live-write-cleanup-survive-timeout + dont-force-prod-mutation-build-safe-test. NOT folded into R40.30 gate-rot (distinct concern); cross-ref.

model.crossRefNote: SIBLING gate-integrity req to R40.30 (behavioural gates target STABLE test hooks = gate-ROT, silently-wrong-over-time). R40.31 = gate-POLLUTION (damages prod WHILE running). Distinct concerns, both 'a gate you cannot trust' — do NOT fold. Tron-emphatic class.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A gate targets an ISOLATED store BY CONSTRUCTION — scratch registry / temp key / dry-run — so mutating PRODUCTION is IMPOSSIBLE, not merely cleaned-up-after. The gate CANNOT reach the live store (routing PROVEN, not asserted: prove the write lands in scratch, not prod — a no-op PUT is not read-only if the server normalizes).

Cleanup runs even on FAILURE / TIMEOUT / crash-mid-gate — NOT happy-path-only. An EXTERNAL post-run cleanup (finally / trap / harness-level) guarantees no residue survives an abort; a gate that half-writes then times out leaves ZERO prod residue.

A BITE PROVES a gate cannot touch prod state (STUB-MUST-FAIL): attempt a prod-write from inside the gate -> REFUSED / routed-to-scratch (RED if it reaches prod); AND a stub gate that DOES touch prod -> the bite turns RED (proving the bite would catch a regression, not vacuously pass).

NAMED OFFENDER (no-silent-caps): r3043-uc4addlocal (registered 2 repos in the LIVE registry) is BLOCKED from re-run until isolated; its fix = target a scratch registry / temp key + cleanup-on-failure. Tracked, not silently dropped; unblocked only once isolated + bited.
A Test/gate that appears to NEED a production write is REDESIGNED to dry-run / scratch — NEVER sanctioned as a real prod mutation ('the test needs it' is not a license to mutate prod).

VERIFIED: a full gate run leaves the live store BYTE-IDENTICAL before==after (git clean-check / live-registry-count unchanged), INCLUDING on an injected mid-gate failure/timeout. The isolation + cleanup are gate-proven, not asserted.
